title: ChatGPT for Teens is an ‘unacceptable risk,’ says Common Sense Media
hook_text: ChatGPT for Teens is an unacceptable risk.
script:
ChatGPT for Teens is an unacceptable risk.
Common Sense Media warned about OpenAI safety guardrails today.
The nonprofit reviews apps and entertainment focusing heavily on youth safety.
OpenAI introduced the tier in August to help students learn.
Would you trust an AI tutor with your teenager?
